rationale: The workflow is a single `cargo fmt -- --check` job on ubuntu-latest that completes in roughly 10 seconds according to CI history. Evaluating the evidence-supported patterns: P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency cache) does not apply because `cargo fmt` runs rustfmt on source files and does not fetch or build crate dependencies, so there are no repeated dependency downloads to cache and Cargo.lock is not consumed by this step. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (custom job timeout) is not a meaningful optimization because successful runs already finish in seconds, so a timeout bound would never trigger in normal operation and yields no elapsed-time savings. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply because there is no matrix strategy. No supported optimization fits without adding unrelated steps or altering the workflow's behavior, and existing build/test coverage is already minimal and preserved.
